caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden plaque hanging from a loop of string at the top. Painted on the plaque is a religious figure, a female dressed in elaborate clothing with a wide, ornate dress adorned with patterns of red and gold, and a dark blue or green mantle draped over her shoulders. The figure's face is small and round, with faint, dark eyes and hair, and it is surrounded by glowing lines or rays. The background is painted with broad, curved strokes in brown and reddish tones, with a suggestion of curtains or drapes framing the scene. Two narrow white shapes, possibly candles, are visible on either side of the figure. The outer area of the image has a light, muted wash, emphasizing the wooden plaque as the focal point. There is handwritten text in brown ink or paint beneath the plaque, possibly identifying the work or providing a caption. The entire composition is centered on a light beige or off-white paper background.
title: Santo
